pin_diff.note: Functionally identical VIN pin (VIN vs IN).
Pin 4 differs (ADJ/NC/NC vs NC/NR/BYPASS): safe only if PCB leaves Pin 4 floating or decoupled via 10 nF to GND; if PCB ties NC pin directly to GND/VIN, trace cut is mandatory.
Functionally identical VOUT pin (VOUT vs OUT).

parameter_matrix.note: Wider operating Vin window supports broader rail & battery chemistry headroom.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_a_value: Ceramic OK · >=2.2 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.part_b_value: Ceramic OK · >=2.2 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: HIGH PIN 4 (NC vs BYPASS/NR) CHECK: One device uses Pin 4 as an internal bandgap bypass/noise-reduction node while the other is NC. Verify Pin 4 is NOT tied to GND or VIN on the existing PCB before swapping; add a 10 nF bypass cap if low noise is required.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: TPS79333DBVR is rated to only 5.5 V rec. (6 V abs max, p.4) vs AP2204K-3.3TRG1 at 24 V rec. (38 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: AP2204K-3.3TRG1 supplies up to 150 mA (p.5) compared to TPS79333DBVR at 200 mA (p.5); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION LIFECYCLE STATUS (NRND): AP2204K-3.3TRG1 is flagged NRND by Diodes Incorporated; do not design into new production layouts — evaluate Active alternatives.
CAUTION THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA differs by 27% (AP2204K-3.3TRG1: 250 °C/W p.4 vs TPS79333DBVR: 182.3 °C/W p.5); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: AP2204K-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-5) and TPS79333DBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to Pin 4 NC vs BYPASS difference; Vin,max rating drops >20%; Iout,max rating drops >20%. Key datasheet deltas: Iq is 20 µA (p.5) vs 250 µA (p.5), max output current is 150 mA (p.5) vs 200 mA (p.5), recommended Vin,max is 24 V (p.4) vs 5.5 V (p.4), typical dropout is 360 mV (p.5) vs 112 mV (p.7), and ceramic capacitor stability is supported vs supported. Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 250 vs 182.3 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
